SELECT player_id, player_name, COUNT(*) AS double_doubles
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
  AND played = 1
  AND ((pts >= 10) + (reb >= 10) + (ast >= 10) + (stl >= 10) + (blk >= 10)) >= 2
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY double_doubles DESC, player_name ASC
LIMIT 10
